answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: every agent posts a 30-credit bond, and its work pattern — timing, task mix, counterparties — is hashed into a kernel of history. At dawn of each epoch the network re-checks each kernel; a fingerprint that suddenly shifts freezes the bond and blocks new work. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 30 = 3,000 credits plus months building each reef of trust, while an honest agent pays 30 once and keeps earning.
